caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the ASR (Attack Success Rate) for different trigger words on the SST-2 dataset with a clean label and a poison rate of 5% (2.6% of total). The x-axis represents various trigger words arranged in ascending order of ASR for the clean model, with labels 'bb', 'mb', 'cf', 'beautiful', 'excellent', 'gorgeous', 'wonderful', 'brilliant', 'stunning', and 'beautifully', on a categorical scale. The y-axis represents the ASR, on a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three lines: a green solid line with no marker representing 'start', an orange solid line with cross markers representing 'random', and a purple solid line with circle markers representing 'end'. The 'start' line begins at approximately 0.2 for 'bb' and ends at around 0.88 for 'beautifully', with a notable peak at 'mb' (around 0.7) and a dip at 'cf' (around 0.37). The 'random' line starts at about 0.55 for 'bb' and ends at around 0.88 for 'beautifully', with a significant dip at 'cf' (around 0.2). The 'end' line starts at approximately 0.5 for 'bb', peaks at 'mb' (around 0.83), and ends at around 0.83 for 'beautifully', with a notable dip at 'wonderful' (around 0.68).
